Generated Narrative: ValueSet ahip-outreach-mode

This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

  • Include these codes as defined in http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ParticipationMode version 📍6.0.0
    CodeDisplayDefinition
    EMAILWRITEmailParticipation by text or diagrams transmitted over an electronic mail system.
    PHONEPhone CallParticipation by voice communication where the voices of the communicating parties are transported over an electronic medium
    MAILWRITMailed LetterParticipation by text or diagrams printed on paper transmitted physically (e.g. by courier service, postal service).
    MSGWRITText MessageParticipation by messaging typically from a mobile phone or mobile device through a cellular network or Internet. Includes secured or unsecured messaging transmission and includes online chat. Also includes submission of photos or other images.
  • Include these codes as defined in http://ahip.org/demographics/CodeSystem/ahip-demo-additional-nullFlavor version 📦0.1.0
    CodeDisplayDefinition
    CNTRI choose not to respond at this timeThis code is to represent explicitly that the patient has chosen not to respond to this question at this time.

name: AHIPOutreachMode
title: AHIP Outreach Modes
description: Used as the answer options for the outreach preferences question in the Language Section, capturing a patient's preferred channels for health care outreach.
